audit.why: 48.72% over 39 games - the largest sample in this champion's table - matches a chart where Garen owns every lane stage and Kassadin takes 2+ items. HARD at 8/10 is consistent with a sub-50% result. No change.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid says 'the silence is on a long cooldown early, so once it's down there's a window'. Decisive Strike is 8 seconds flat at every rank and costs nothing.
audit.why: An 8-second free silence is not a window you can plan a trade around - it is back before your Null Sphere is. That single number changes the whole gameplan from 'bait the Q' to 'never be inside 300 range'.
audit.corrected: Rewrote content.mid, breakdown.cooldowns, report[9].t and loading around the real 8s / 22s / 120s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were missing entirely. (1) Decisive Strike breaks free of ALL slows affecting him, so Force Pulse cannot kite him - he simply cleanses it and keeps walking. (2) The full layer tracked Courage as the matchup-definer and never mentioned that the Q silence locks Riftwalk, which is the only reason this lane is dangerous at all. Also, dosFull[1] and tradeGood both promise 'the shield absorbs his counter' - Null Sphere shields magic, and Garen is physical and true damage only.
audit.why: Riot: 'Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack ... deals bonus damage and silencing them'; 'Demacian Justice ... attempt to execute an enemy champion' with a trueDamage flag; Null Sphere 'absorbs magic damage'.
audit.corrected: Wrote both into report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad, loading, content.spikes[0].text and content.wants.foe[0]; removed the shield promise from the trade lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' and 'Mercs or Sorcs' boots.
audit.why: Garen deals no magic damage at all, so Plated Steelcaps is the boot; and his sustain is Perseverance, which only ticks when he has NOT recently been struck - so a single point of chip denies it, which is cheaper than an item.
audit.corrected: report[8].t and dosFull[1] rewritten around chip damage and armour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every window in the full layer was 'when Courage is down' with no duration.
audit.why: Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s and it is the only cooldown long enough to plan around - his Q at 8s and E at 9s are effectively always available.

notes: The biggest correction here is a cooldown, not a name: content.mid told you to bait the silence because it is 'on a long cooldown early'. Decisive Strike is 8 seconds flat at every rank and free to cast - there is no window, and a player waiting for one will keep dying inside 300 range. Two interactions were missing from the entire file: Decisive Strike breaks all slows affecting him (so Force Pulse cannot kite Garen at all), and the silence locks Riftwalk. The full layer also promised 'the shield absorbs his counter' in three places - Null Sphere shields magic and Garen deals none.
